hypothesis: With opaque identities and no provided latent state labels or monomial rules, a direct weight writer can construct from 20 real public transition interventions a two-step action-consequence representation enabling 128/128 held-out action1 reward predictions across 32 public worlds. Strong exact symbolic two-step matcher should tie; one-step and state-ID memorization controls should fail. A hidden held-out-only action1 shift causes 128 errors before evidence and only fail-closed abstention after first contradiction.
primary_metric: Exact binary action1 rewards on four unseen third-replica states in each of 32 frozen synthetic worlds, no training label leakage.
frozen_experiment: Exactly protocol.json as written, no further change after first run; user-specified research-first-use authority absent, DEV only.
comparison: Independent symbolic signature map, one-step ablation, exact state-ID memorizer, erased state, and a fully trained-to-frozen-loss-budget 33-param 2-8-1 Adam MLP using identical signatures and 8 public action1 labels. Report nonconvergence as not scientifically qualified.
controls: stratified 32 seeds and all 16 arbitrary mappings twice
no hidden latent q or seed-to-mask supplied to any learner
adversarial heldout-only shift and genuine contradiction observation
cold canonical restore and previously seen event replay
fail-closed corrupted checkpoint/invalid input and wrong-world namespace behavior
scoring: Abstention counts as incorrect on binary reward task; separately count false-decisions and abstentions. Identical public information across models. Train budget <=2048 Adam steps and convergence BCE<=0.02; if not achieved, do not call MLP fully trained.
science_status: Only public author-visible synthetic DEV evidence, no independent scientific first-use. Symbolic tie proves no performance advantage; unknown mathematical primitive discovery not established, since the two-step signature representation is specified as allowed learner algorithm.
invalid: Any modification of data budget, environment dynamics, seeds, heldout task, stop threshold, negative or scoring after outcomes; separately disclosed implementation bug fixes allowed only for engineering and require full final requalification.
